featured_reviews.name: Suprabha Keshava Ram Bonanthaya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our recent trip with Navkar Travels was extremely stressful and disappointing due to poor planning, lack of accountability, and constant justification instead of solutions.

Before the trip, we specifically asked Mr. Sidharth whether we should take VIP tickets for temple visits. He clearly advised that there was no need. Because of this incorrect guidance, at Bhimashankar we were unable to visit the temple at all, which was a major disappointment. Later, this was explained away as “rush due to closure,” rather than taking responsibility. This became a pattern—every concern was met with reasons, not resolutions.

The itinerary planning was careless. Ellora was included in our plan, but Navkar Travels failed to cross-check closure days, and when we reached, Ellora was closed, resulting in a complete miss of the visit. Such basic planning errors are unacceptable from a professional travel operator.

Although proper coordination was promised, there was no regular communication from their side. Despite multiple issues throughout the journey, we had to keep following up repeatedly.

Accommodation Experience

To be fair, rooms at Pune and Ahilyanagar were good and comfortable.

However, at Nashik and Aurangabad, accommodation was arranged through OYO, and the experience there was very poor:
•	Unhygienic rooms with cockroaches
•	Torn bed sheets and foul-smelling pillows
•	Dirty toilets
•	No hot water
•	Lift not working
•	At one location, no bed was arranged for our children, despite clearly informing them that kids were travelling with us. Only after repeated calls was some arrangement managed.

Vehicle & Travel Issues
•	We had to wake the driver every morning to start the day’s travel
•	The bus had exposed nails in the luggage area, due to which two of our luggage bags got torn
•	Instead of accepting responsibility, we were blamed for carrying “big luggage”
•	We were 8 members travelling for 8 days—expecting backpacks is unrealistic
•	Due to fear of further damage, luggage had to be kept inside the seating area
•	Seat cushioning was very poor and uncomfortable

On the positive side, the driver was not an alcoholic or smoker, which we appreciated. Also, the AC in the bus worked well, which genuinely helped us cope during the journey.

Serious Documentation Concern

One very serious issue was with road transport documentation. During a highway check, we discovered that the documents were issued under someone else’s name, not related to our trip. Thankfully, the officer did not cross-check further. Otherwise, we could have faced major legal trouble, despite no fault of ours. This was extremely concerning and unacceptable.

Overall

For a family travelling with children and elders, this level of mismanagement, hygiene issues, poor coordination, and documentation risk is unacceptable. The experience did not justify the money spent or the trust placed in Navkar Travels.

I hope this review helps future travellers make an informed decision and encourages Navkar Travels to focus on professionalism, safety, and genuine customer care instead of explanations for every failure.

Best beaches in Kerala - Varkala, Kovalam & Alleppey
Kerala has 600 km of coastline. These are the 3 beaches actually worth your time.

Varkala - the cliff beach
Red laterite cliffs towering over the Arabian Sea. This is the one that doesn't look real in photos. The northern end is safest for swimming. Surf schools available. Best for: couples, backpackers, those who want something dramatic.

Kovalam - the most complete beach destination
Three connected bays: Lighthouse Beach (most popular), Hawa Beach (calmer), and Samudra Beach. Parasailing, catamaran rides, ayurvedic spas, and a solid lineup of restaurants. Best for: first-timers, families, those who want everything in one place.

Alleppey - not a beach but a must
Technically a backwater destination, but the combination of beach + houseboat + lagoon makes it essential on any Kerala trip. Best for: houseboat experience, couples, anyone who wants to slow down.

When to go:
→ October to March: ideal — dry, calm sea, swimming-safe
→ June to September: no swimming, but the landscape is extraordinary and Ayurveda treatments are considered best this season
→ April–May: hot but good for domestic travellers

We used them to travel to Andaman recently. They never took the time to understand our needs properly and did not communicate back clearly. However we were stuck with them because we had paid upfront. It was impossible to get any answers from them to our queries. Every time we asked something they would say they need to check with Hardik who was never available. They pushed an island hopping boat tour on us for Rs 1.2 lacs with upfront payment. It was supposed to take us to 4 islands and take us for snorkeling. Turns out the worst boat I have ever been in. It was a dinghy little boat, dirty with no safety measures. The crew was 2 people who seemed hardly qualified to operate a boat let alone take us snorkeling in the middle of the ocean. There were no safety briefings or processes explained before the ride. The ride was very choppy because it was such a small boat. We also found out that 3 of the 4 islands were only supposed to be seen from the boat (no landing allowed). Figure that! We went to just 1 island and asked the crew to take us back. An 8 hour tour had to be cut down to 3 hours with 2 hours and 45 minutes spent on the boat.

An absolutely disastrous travel agency. Absolutely crappy service with no proper communications and pushing third grade products on customers. Would never use them again and would advise others to stay away.

featured_reviews.name: Rafik Lulania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Memorable and Amazing Europe Tour with LPO Holidays was nothing less than a dream come true.

Travelling across Europe for 16 days with LPO Holidays has been the experience of a lifetime — and the credit goes to our LPO Tour Manager NASIR BHAI, the heart and backbone of this journey.
Always patient, always smiling, and always 10 steps ahead… he made sure not a single moment felt mismanaged. His stories, knowledge, and care turned this tour into memories we will cherish forever.

We, a group of 45 members from Palghar, had dreamt for years of exploring Europe — and LPO Holidays made it happen, that too at a fantastic price.
Special thanks to owner Mr. Sushil Sir, who personally came to Palghar, explained everything with clarity, and — most importantly — delivered exactly what he promised.

Perfect arrangements from start to end: luxurious coach, comfortable hotels, fabulous meals (veg, non-veg, Jain), and even unexpected treats like pani puri, pav bhaji, jalebi, mutton, fish, and all European delicacies from pizzas to black forest cake.
Guide Mr. Nasir Shaikh, with 27 years of experience, was exceptional — knowledgeable, humble, and always helpful.
Our coach captain Mr. Andriez kept us safe and comfortable with smooth driving.

We explored Italy, Austria, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, and Switzerland — from Rome, Pisa, Venice, Frankfurt, Hallstatt, Brussels, Paris to 4 magical days in Switzerland.
The cruise rides in Venice and Paris were unforgettable.

Even during a medical emergency when Mrs. Mangala Jirapure suffered a minor stroke, LPO and Nasir bhai handled the situation like true professionals.
Nasir bhai rushed with her in the ambulance, coordinated with hospital and LPO team, and still ensured the rest of the group had a smooth tour.
This dedication is rare, and we are deeply grateful.

Everything — literally everything — about the tour was perfect.

And then came the only issue — a flight delay at Kuwait Airport.

Last day we reached Milan to fly Mumbai via Kuwait Airways. Due to dense fog and Kuwait Airways’ own operational problems, we were stuck in Kuwait Airport for 20 hours.

And let’s be very clear here —
Fog aur airline delay ka LPO se koi rishta nahi hota.
Unhe blame karna utna hi unreasonable hai jitna mausam ko complaint email bhejna.

Hum sabne poora Europe tour enjoy kiya — hotels top, food top, sightseeing top, management top.
LPO ne apni taraf se 100% diya.

Isliye feedback TOUR ke hisaab se hi dunga.

Airline ka mess LPO ke khate me daalna not just unfair — it’s misplaced and honestly, thoda ajeeb lagta hai.

Airline claim ka follow-up alag se chal raha hai, but uski wajah se poori tour performance ko question karna sahi baat nahi.

We all enjoyed the entire trip with family, took all the benefits, but now suddenly blaming LPO for airline fog delay… honestly, it says more about US than about LPO.

Thank you LPO Holidays, Sushil Ji, Nasir Bhai, Seema, Amit and the entire team for turning our European dream into reality — with luxury, care, and perfection.

Looking forward to many more international trips with LPO.

Warm regards,
Shamim Lulania
